description: The parked-engine rebind's slow mode: the drafter window's join compiles shape-keyed programs (and, on a kernel-cache miss, JIT-builds kernels) for every new prompt-length split; the tile-aligned window makes the set of shapes fixed

levers.name: tile-aligned drafter window
levers.reason: the five tap windows [P-2048, P) are snapshotted as tile-aligned pieces and joined by one tiled concat (fixed 2080 rows) and one slice at (P-2048) mod 32, instead of a concat of unaligned pieces whose untilize/concat/retilize programs (and untilize writer kernels) are keyed by the split; data movement only, so bit-identical (the audit compares today's composition on every chip)

image_files.reason: the lever's flags, aligned bounds, join plan, joins and audit compare; dflash_prefill_window (already overlaid) imports it only when QWEN_FAST_TAP_WINDOW_ALIGNED is set and not 0

notes: dflash_prefill_window.py is edited on this branch and is already an overlay line (docker/qwen-c2-overlay.txt): no new line for it. rebind_split.py is a host-side reader (the RB pack's READ), not an image file. Card jobs: references/fusion-jobs/RB (ORDER.txt); their -fx-twa and -fx-twa-audit profiles exist only once make_fusion_profiles.py --write has run on the integrated branch.
